# Iteration57: structured B loads and cache-swizzle ablation

Adapt the current WASP operand-load mechanism: structured idxen/offen B descriptors, opaque invariant address operands, scalar K offsets, and bulk direct-to-LDS A copies. Compare original/transposed internal mapping, cache-swizzle on/off, and interleaved/slab A producer mapping. All external INT8 NT / INT32 / no-scale semantics and actual group counts are preserved.

120 full-range INT8/FP64 boundary checks and40 representative performance-output checks PASS. Eight kernels use243-244 VGPRs with no scratch or spills. Original dimensions, physical GPU7, three HIP-event samples with warmup2/repeat5, median.

CACHE_SWIZZLE is enabled only for supported power-of-two multiples of64-byte stride. K6144/K7168 contiguous strides do not enable it, so differences there cannot be attributed to this bit. Contiguous and padded inputs are both checked. Representative improvements do not establish all1178 acceptance; the public default is unchanged.
